name: @pipeworx/mcp-ipinfo

tools.name: lookup_ip
tools.description: Get geolocation and network info for any IP address (e.g., "8.8.8.8"). Returns city, region, country, coordinates, org, postal code, timezone.

ip.description: IPv4 or IPv6 address to look up (e.g., "8.8.8.8")

tools.name: get_my_ip
tools.description: Get your current IP address with geolocation data. Returns city, region, country, coordinates, org, postal code, timezone.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-ipinfo forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the ipinfo pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
